headline.label: Mortgage foreclosures filed
headline.sentence: Mortgage foreclosures filed in Bilbao fell 33% over the year to 2026-Q1.

regime.reading: No rule fired. The city's measures are within their ordinary range, or too few of them are currently available to classify.

top_signature.label: Regulatory shock
top_signature.summary: Short-term-rental supply contracts while visitor demand does not. Listings and licensed tourist dwellings fall together with hotel demand steady or rising — the fingerprint of a rule change rather than a demand change.

top_signature.label: Tourism shock
top_signature.summary: Visitor demand moves independently of the local economy. Flights, hotel nights and port arrivals turn together while employment and housing lag behind — a shock arriving from outside the city rather than inside it.

top_signature.label: Orderly cooling
top_signature.summary: Heat leaving the market without anyone being forced. Prices and transactions decelerate while employment holds and the distress measures stay flat. This is the benign case, and it is worth being able to name it.
